acceptanceCriteria: Breadcrumbs are byte-reproducible from the indexed revision and contain no generated text.
A row's pinned blob hash and line range are identical with and without breadcrumb matching.
A packet row that matched only through its breadcrumb says so in its reason.
Measured on the frozen retrieval evaluation.
body: Owner requested this on 2026-09-23 after reviewing Tencent/WeKnora (MIT) as prior art; this ticket records an idea, not delivery or promotion. Original Go work only; no source import. WeKnora is an LLM-at-ingest, database-backed RAG platform, so only the mechanism is borrowed and it must stay deterministic, local and read-only under AGENTS.md invariants 4 and 7. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Prior art: website-docs/03-features/04-chunking.md of https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora. Heading breadcrumbs are persisted in a separate `context_header` column and only feed the embedding content through `EmbeddingContent()`, so titles guide matching while `StartAt`/`EndAt` offsets are untouched. Current state: internal/contextindex/parse.go already recognises headings, but a row's lexical text is the row's own lines; a section of docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md does not match on its spec title or parent heading, and a Go declaration does not match on its package or file role. V1-0096 asks for a derived role line per file; this ticket is the deterministic carrier for it. Idea: derive a breadcrumb per row (Markdown heading path; Go package, file and enclosing declaration) at index time from repository content only, store it as separate match text, and exclude it from the pinned line range and from the returned bytes. Owning spec: docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md. Related: V1-0096.
title: context: breadcrumb match text stored beside rows without changing pinned line ranges
